---
name: Bug report
about: A tool returned an error or a wrong result
labels: bug
---

**Tool and arguments**
e.g. `evtx(image="E4", ref="/Windows/System32/winevt/Logs/Security.evtx", event_ids=[1102])`

**What happened**
Full error text or the wrong value.

**What you expected**

**Environment**
Output of `fea doctor`, and the image/file-system type (NTFS, ext4, ...).

**Notes**
Do not attach case data. A description of the artefact (size, version, how it was produced) is enough.
